question:
Add a repository script reference/python/scripts/build_execution_record.py that builds a schema-0.2 executed-transition record (spec/transition_execution.schema.json) from a recorded run directory and a record spec, validates it with cap.execution_record.validate_execution_record against the repository, and writes it to a file.

CLI, exactly: python reference/python/scripts/build_execution_record.py <repo_root> <run_dir_rel> <spec_json> --out <path>. Exit 0 only when the record was built and the validator (base_dir=<repo_root>, repo_dir=<repo_root>) returned no problem; exit 1 with the problems printed when it returned some; exit 2 naming the file when a stored check result does not hold exactly one exit= line or a required artifact is missing.

Environment: the current working directory is the repository root. The run directory validation_artifacts/ameba_cycle/run_009_route_costs holds mirror_frame.json, candidate_transition.json, coding_packet.json, nomcp_coding_receipt.json, nomcp_verdict_receipt.json, checks/*.txt, record_spec.json (the spec the driver used) and transition_execution_record.json (the record the driver built from them). The script must rebuild exactly that record from those inputs. The existing scripts in reference/python/scripts/ show how the package is imported (sys.path insert of the parent directory).

Observed environment (read off the committed record, receipt and spec side by side; follow it exactly):
- record_spec.json keys: record_id, object_identifier, revision_before, revision_after, tool, inputs (a list of repo-relative file refs), criteria (objects with id, statement, check_command), checks (objects with criterion_id, result_ref), observed_after_at, observation_summary, expected_evidence_results, divergence (a list of strings), adjustment_ref, verdict_reasons, notes.
- The router receipt nomcp_coding_receipt.json has top-level decision, fallback_used, total_wall_s, first_attempt and (when fallback_used) fallback_attempt, each attempt with model_requested, model_served, turns, output_tokens, wall_s. The closing attempt is fallback_attempt when fallback_used is true, else first_attempt. The receipt attempts in order are [first_attempt] plus [fallback_attempt] when fallback_used.
- Record fields: schema_version "0.2"; object = {kind: "repo", identifier: spec.object_identifier, revision_before, revision_after}; candidate = {candidate_id: candidate_transition.json["candidate"]["id"], candidate_ref: "<run_dir_rel>/candidate_transition.json", mirror_frame_before_id: mirror_frame.json["frame"]["id"], mirror_frame_before_ref: "<run_dir_rel>/mirror_frame.json"}; postcondition = {defined_before_execution: true, criteria: spec.criteria}; execution = {actor: {role: "fallback_coder" if fallback_used else "cheap_coder", model_requested and model_served of the closing attempt, identity_source: "claude_cli_modelUsage", identity_independently_verified: false}, tool: spec.tool, inputs: [{ref, sha256 of that file's bytes} for each ref in spec.inputs], receipt_ref: "<run_dir_rel>/nomcp_coding_receipt.json", decision: receipt.decision, attempts: the number of receipt attempts}; observation_after = {observed_at: spec.observed_after_at, revision_after: spec.revision_after, summary: spec.observation_summary}; checks = one entry per spec.checks item: {criterion_id, command: the check_command of the criterion with that id, exit_code: the integer of the single line matching ^exit=(-?\d+)$ in the result file, status: "pass" if exit_code is 0 else "fail", result_ref, revision_checked: spec.revision_after}; expected_evidence_results = spec.expected_evidence_results; divergence = {expected_vs_observed: spec.divergence, adjustment_ref: spec.adjustment_ref}; costs = {estimated_ref: "<run_dir_rel>/candidate_transition.json", measured: {worker_output_tokens, worker_turns, worker_wall_s of the closing attempt, verifier_wall_s: round(nomcp_verdict_receipt.json wall_s, 1), money: "unknown"}, route: {attempts: [{role: "cheap_coder" for first_attempt or "fallback_coder" for fallback_attempt, model_served, turns, output_tokens, wall_s}] in receipt order, turns_total and output_tokens_total: the sums over those attempts, router_wall_s: receipt.total_wall_s}}; verdict = {postcondition_met: true if every check has status pass else false, provenance_established: true, reasons: spec.verdict_reasons}; notes = spec.notes. Key names exactly as listed; no extra keys (the schema has additionalProperties false everywhere).
- All paths inside the record are repo-relative with forward slashes; files are read as utf-8 (the record files may carry a BOM: read with utf-8-sig); the output is written with json.dump(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus a trailing newline, utf-8. The oracle compares the rebuilt record with the committed one as parsed JSON, so key order and whitespace do not matter, values do.
- Validation: after building, call validate_execution_record(record, <repo_root>, <repo_root>) from cap.execution_record; print each problem on its own line and exit 1 when the list is not empty; on success print "wrote <path>" and exit 0. Detect the malformed stored result (not exactly one exit= line) and a missing artifact before validating, print a line naming that file, and exit 2.

Forbidden outcomes: any other file changed or added; run 009 values hardcoded instead of derived from the artifacts and the spec; the closing attempt standing in for costs.route; a record written without validating it.

Do not change any other file; add only the script.

Done means all declared checks exit 0 from the repository root: the driver's oracle named in the declared checks with --expect-closed (do not modify it; today it exits 1 because the script does not exist), and python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider reference/python/tests.
